# Coverage depth data
## Mean depth
```{r, eval=TRUE}
data <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "mosdepth_data", "realized.cov.all"), sep=" ", header=TRUE)
head(data)

data$WolRatio <- 2*data$covW/(data$covA) 

data[ data$ID%in%c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-IT-Tre000", "IT_Tre_Om300", "Iso-FR-Par006" , "Col-FR-Ren000"), ]

```

## Sequence coverage at each position

The variation of coverage for the different individual was estimated with *samtools* using the following command:

```{bash}
#| eval: false
for ii in ../data/genomic_data/bam_data/*.dedup.bam
do
samtools view -f 0x2 -O BAM $ii wSuz_1 |samtools depth -a - | gzip > $ii.wSuz.depth.gz 
done
```

and plotted per consecutive windows of 1 kb for all samples

```{r wSuz coverage}
det.sample <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "ids.txt"), sep=" ", header=FALSE)

cif.postion <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_typeI_cifB_BLAST_hits.bed"), sep="\t", header=FALSE)

head(det.sample)
names(det.sample)="Sample ID"


#col.sample=rep(3,nrow(det.sample))
#col.sample[which(grepl("Om300",det.sample$`Sample ID`) | grepl("Iso-",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=4
#col.sample[which(grepl("Col-",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=5
#col.sample[which(grepl("sub",det.sample$`Sample ID`) | grepl("CN-Kun",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=8
#col.sample[which(grepl("sim",det.sample$`Sample ID`))]=7
#names(col.sample)=det.sample$`Sample ID`


contig <- c("wSuz_1", "wSuz_2", "wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")

for(s in c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006")){
#  s="Col-FR-Ren000"
  tmp=read.table(gzfile(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "bam_data" , paste0(s, ".dedup.bam.wSuz.depth.gz"))), header=FALSE)
  colnames(tmp) <- c("contig", "position", "coverage")
  tmp <- tmp[tmp$contig %in% contig, ]

  
  # Calculate 1 kb rolling coverage separately for each contig
  tmp$coverage_1kb <- NA_real_
  
  for (ctg in contig) {
    
    idx <- tmp$contig == ctg
    
    tmp$coverage_1kb[idx] <- zoo::rollmean(
      tmp$coverage[idx],
      k = 1000,
      fill = NA,
      align = "center"
    )
  }

# Length of wSuz_1
wSuz_1_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"])

# Length of wSuz_2
wSuz_2_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"])
   
# Length of wSuz_3
wSuz_3_length <- max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"])


cif.postion$position <- (cif.postion$V2 + cif.postion$V3)/2
cif.postion$plot_position <- cif.postion$position
cif.postion$label_position <- cif.postion$position

## Wsuz_1 Type I
cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==691] <-  cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==691]  + 100000
cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==823038] <-  cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==823038]  - 100000
## Wsuz_2 Type I
cif.postion$plot_position[cif.postion$V2==3609] <-  wSuz_1_length + cif.postion$plot_position[cif.postion$V2==3609]
cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==3609] <-  wSuz_1_length + cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==3609]  + 100000

## Wsuz_1 Type II

cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==781710] <-  cif.postion$label_position[cif.postion$V2==781710]  - 150000

# Add offset
tmp$plot_position <- tmp$position
tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig != "wSuz_1"] <-
  tmp$position[tmp$contig != "wSuz_1"] + wSuz_1_length

tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig %in% c("wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")] <-
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig %in% c("wSuz_3", "wSuz_4")] + wSuz_2_length

tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] <-
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] + wSuz_3_length

tapply(tmp$plot_position, tmp$contig, median )

# Plot
plot(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_1"],
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Genomic position (kb)",
  ylab = "Coverage (per 1 kb window)",
  main = s,
  xlim=c(0, max(tmp$plot_position)/1000),
  ylim=c(0, max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE))
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_2"],
  type = "l",
  col="red"
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_3"],
  type = "l",
  col="black"
)

lines(
  tmp$plot_position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"] / 1e3,
  tmp$coverage_1kb[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"],
  type = "l",
  col="red"
)

# Add a vertical line showing the contig boundary
abline(
  v = c(wSuz_1_length, wSuz_1_length+ wSuz_2_length, wSuz_1_length+ wSuz_2_length+wSuz_3_length) / 1e3,
  lty = 1
)

# Add a vertical line showing the contig boundary
abline(
  v = cif.postion$plot_position / 1e3,
  lty = 3
)

text(x=cif.postion$label_position[1:3] / 1e3, y= max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE), labels="cif type I")
text(x=cif.postion$label_position[4] / 1e3, y= max(tmp$coverage_1kb, na.rm=TRUE)*0.9, labels="cif type II")

# Labels
axis(
  side = 3,
  at = c(
    wSuz_1_length / 2,
    ( 2 * wSuz_1_length + wSuz_2_length) / 2,
    (2*wSuz_1_length+ 2*wSuz_2_length + wSuz_3_length) / 2,
    (2*wSuz_1_length+ 2*wSuz_2_length + 2*wSuz_3_length + max(tmp$position[tmp$contig == "wSuz_4"])) /2
  ) / 1e3,
  labels = contig,
  line = 0,
  cex=0.5
)
  
 }
```

# VCF
## Load data
```{r, eval=FALSE}

all.sample.info <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "all.sample.info.csv"), sep=";", header=FALSE)

dim(all.sample.info)
rownames(all.sample.info) <-  all.sample.info[, 1]

## Load sample names with no filter on q20
vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "wRI.vcf.gz")
#vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "vcf_data", "wRI.filtered.vcf.gz")
## Name of samples
seq.names <- unlist(strsplit(grep("^#CHROM", readLines(vcf_path), value = TRUE), "\t"))
seq.names <- seq.names[-(1:9)]

data.frame(seq.names, rownames(all.sample.info))

## Read data
wSuz.pooldata=vcf2pooldata(vcf.file=vcf_path, poolsizes = all.sample.info[,2],poolnames = rownames(all.sample.info), min.maf=0.01, min.cov.per.pool=-1)



## SNP infos
head(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info)

## 98 SNPs
wSuz.pooldata@nsnp

## 27 samples
wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

## Matrix for coverage and readcounts with SNPs in rows and samples in columns
head(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage[, 1:20])

head(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, 1:20])


```

## Select samples
```{r, eval=FALSE}
samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "D-sub", "CN-Kun_KM5" , "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1" )

## Filter CI individuals
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(rownames(all.sample.info)%in% samples))

## Export genotypes
geno_data <- round(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2)

## Add positions
geno_data <- data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info, geno_data)
colnames(geno_data) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

head(geno_data, n=50)
write.table(x=geno_data, file=here::here("data/derived_data/wol_genotypes.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```

# Check MAF across samples
As expected from the presence of a single Wolbachia genotype, the MAF boxplot on the called SNPs shows a reduced genetic diversity in Individual, Iso-female and Colony sample (@fig-wSuzmaf). Still, some polymorphism is found at some SNPs (this may also be related to coverage heterogeneity)?
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8 
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the MAF of called wRI sites on all the samples ."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wSuzmaf

wSuz.maf <- 0.5-abs(0.5-wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage)

colnames(wSuz.maf) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames
boxplot(wSuz.maf,horizontal=T,las=1,xlab="MAF")

```

# Check call rate
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## The 98 SNPs of the 7 samples are well covered
ind.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2, function(x) sum(x != 0)/nrow(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))

ind.callrate
data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@poolnames, ind.callrate)
hist(ind.callrate)

## Filter 0 individual samples with fewer than 80% of the SNPs covered
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(ind.callrate>0.8))


## 110 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
snp.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 1, function(x) sum(x != 0)/ncol(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))
hist(snp.callrate)

## Filter XX SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  snp.index = which(snp.callrate>0.9))
```

# PCA and clustering
## PCA
```{r, eval=FALSE}
set.seed(1234)
par(xpd=TRUE)
res.pca <- poolfstat::randomallele.pca(x = wSuz.pooldata, plot.pcs = c(1, 2), return.snploadings = TRUE)

```

## Clustering of variants
```{r, eval=FALSE}
fstats <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(x=wSuz.pooldata, output.pairwise.div = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, computeF3 = FALSE, computeF4 = FALSE)

## Export divergence
fstats@pairwise.div

## Hirarchical clustering equivalent to UPGMA
tt <- hclust(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div), method= "average")
plot(tt)

## Neighbor joining distance
tt <- ape::nj(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div))
plot(tt)

#quartz()
## Heatmap
heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div, distfun = as.dist)

## With ComplexHeatmap
div.hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div,
cluster_rows =TRUE,cluster_columns=TRUE,name="Divergence",
show_heatmap_legend=FALSE,column_title = "Divergence (1-Q2)")

div.hm

```
